model_provenance.candidate_artifact_limitation: External quantized weights/calibration artifacts are not discovered automatically; supply their separate manifest before claiming full candidate reproducibility.

policy: Both requests reset KV and prefill prompt[:-1] in canonical chunks8 with B4 tails; Both use FP64 prefill projections and FP32 scalar final-prompt/decode. Both retain batched prefill attention; Identical compiled math and8workers; only worker startup QoS selector changes DEFAULT to USER_INITIATED. Coordinator untouched, no core placement guarantee. No prefix reuse or suffix verification.
limitations: Two resident models; sequential warmed inference in alternating order. Direct acknowledged/closed dumps preserve worker pools after warmup. No OS cache eviction or hard host isolation. Full-logit bits and fixed greedy IDs must match; separate causal/cache/sampled verification gates required.
